items.title: Video to Notes
items.summary: A side panel that turns any captioned video into organised notes with clickable timestamps, a searchable transcript and a place to ask questions.
highlights: Reads captions on YouTube, Vimeo and any page with an HTML5 video
Three note lengths, streamed from the Claude API with the transcript cached for follow-up questions
Sends notes to Notion, Markdown files, Obsidian or a webhook
